content: मङ्गल {%a.%} [मङ्ग्-अलच्; <ls>Uṇ. 5. 70</ls>] .²1 Auspicious, lucky, propitious, fortunate; मङ्गलदिवसः, मङ्गलवृषभः <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 Prosperous, doing or faring well. .²3 Brave. .{@-लम्@} .²1 .³({%a%}) Auspiciousness, propitiousness; जनकानां रघूणां च यत् कृत्स्नं गोत्रमङ्गलम् <ls>U. 6. 42</ls>; <ls>R. 6. 9</ls>, <ls n="R.">10. 67</ls>. .³({%b%}) Happiness, good luck or fortune, bliss, felicity; भद्रं भद्रं वितर भगवन् भूयसे मङ्गलाय <ls>Māl. 1. 3</ls>; <ls>U. 3. 48</ls>. .³({%c%}) Wellbeing, welfare, good; सङ्गः सतां किमु न मङ्गलमातनोति <ls>Bv. 1. 122</ls>; (also {%m.%} in these senses). .²2 A good omen, anything tending to an auspicious issue. .²3 A blessing, benediction. .²4 An auspicious or lucky object. .²5 An auspicious occasion or event, a festivity. .²6 Any solemn or auspicious ceremony or rite (such as marriage). .²7 Any ancient custom. .²8 Turmeric. .²9 (In music) A particular composition. .{@-लः@} .²1 The planet Mars. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of Agni. .{@-ला, -ली@} .²1 A faithful wife .²2 Dūrvā grass. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of Durgā.
